relations.subject: Baburam Acharya
relations.evidence: the names of two Nepalese, Baburam Acharya and Mahant (monk) Naraharinath, come readily to our notice. Both were connected with a monthly in Sanskrit devoted exclusively to historical writing.

relations.subject: Dhanavajra Vajracharya
relations.object: Centre for Nepalese and Asian Studies, T.U.
relations.evidence: The sum total of the research appeared ... in a separate book ‘Lichchhavi Kalka Abhilekha’ edited by Dhanavajra Vajracharya. The work was published by Centre for Nepalese and Asian Studies, T.U.
